north_star: Author-facing narrative knowledge workspace, not runtime artifact viewer.
information_architecture: Workspace header with title, language, read-only status, health summary
Left rail for primary product surfaces: Overview, Graph, Wiki, Review, Canon, Dev
Right inspector for selected node/note/review item
Dev details collapsed and separated from author workflow

project_selection.author_ui: Show one active story workspace. Project switcher hidden behind compact menu.
project_selection.dev_ui: Show markdown_vault and runtime root only inside Dev artifacts drawer.

graph_redesign.global_graph: Primary relationship map with filters, legend, selected node dock, adaptive labels, no edge labels by default.
graph_redesign.local_graph: Explicit selected-node neighborhood mode, depth control, narrative relation list paired with mini graph.
graph_redesign.layout: Fit-to-content, padding, hub-centered character bias, collision, stable seed, reset layout, no rail-like grid.

actions: Open wiki note when not current
Copy note path only in dev details

copy_i18n.rule: No mixed language in primary UX; dev/audit copy also translated when visible.

review_queue_redesign.author_facing: Decision queue with grouped duplicates, unresolved links, weak summaries, and chapter issues.
review_queue_redesign.avoid: Raw audit dumps as first view.

future_editor_affordance.copy: Coming next: edit Markdown note / propose canon patch.
future_editor_affordance.placement: Only in node/note inspector when context exists.

acceptance_criteria: Author can identify active story workspace in under 3 seconds.
markdown_vault is not presented as a normal project in author mode.
Sera/Ren open character canonical cards with bio/facts.
Graph initial view has no clipped border nodes and no dominant rails.
Primary UI in Spanish runtime has no English core labels.
No dead or ambiguous action buttons in primary node detail.
Technical metadata is collapsed or in Dev mode.
